Name: Shells Collection - Beach Forages and Decorations
Author: ItsBenter
Description:
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/LQeyWhM.png[/img][/b]
This mod is made to increase the variety of beach forages. It got many little things where the shells can be used for like craftables, barters, and cookings.
[list]
[*][size=2]10 shells / beach forages[/size]
[*][size=2]2 crab pot fishes[/size]
[*][size=2]4 cookings[/size]
[*][size=2]3 craftables[/size]
[*][size=2]17 scarecrows[/size]
[*][size=2]10 furnitures[/size]
[*][size=2]1 special order[/size]
[/list][size=2]More information including the spawn, gift taste, shop listings, and more is available on the mod's "[url=https://github.com/itsbenter/ShellsCollection/]wiki[/url]﻿".

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CqcVhaz.png[/img]
[list]
[*][size=2]Beach Forages spawn in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew[/url]﻿ maps.[/size]
[*][size=2]Gift taste for some [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] NPC's[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HNm7QJU.png[/img]
[/size]1. Is it safe to add Shells Collection mid-save?
It is safe! The additional content added by this mod will work just fine.
2. How do I get this item?The items are designed to be encountered naturally as the game carry on. If you're really curious you can read the "[url=https://github.com/itsbenter/ShellsCollection/]wiki[/url]﻿".
3. Is this mod compatible with that mod?
I don't really know. You are free to try, and if you'd like you can report the finding. It will surely be helpful to others.

[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/WtvzZ9s.png[/img][/b]

[size=1]Tiny reminder: endorse the mod if you like it. It means more people will see it, and it makes the author happy. :)[/size]
